description: Runs zRev's ROI model on one company's numbers and returns, as plain text, the projected annual impact in USD split into pipeline lift, customer acquisition cost savings and the value of hours returned to the team, followed by the model's assumptions and a link to the interactive calculator preset to the same inputs. Use when a user wants a number for their own company; all six inputs are required, so ask for any that are missing rather than guessing. The output is an estimate from a fixed model, not a forecast or a quote. Pure calculation: nothing is stored, no external calls, no authentication, no rate limit.

arr.description: Annual recurring revenue in USD, e.g. 10000000

cac.description: Customer acquisition cost per new customer in USD, e.g. 8000

close_rate_pct.description: Close rate as a percentage, e.g. 15 for 15%

deal_size.description: Average deal size in USD, e.g. 25000

team_size.description: Number of people on the GTM team, account executives plus SDRs, e.g. 8

name: estimate_roi
title: Estimate the ROI of AI across a GTM motion
